stemMarkdown: Pipe A can fill a cistern in 4 hours and pipe B can fill it in 16 hours. If both pipes are opened together, how long will they take to fill the cistern? (2 decimal places, in hours.)
solutionMarkdown: A's rate $= 1/4$ of the cistern per hour, B's rate $= 1/16$. Combined rate $= 1/4 + 1/16 = 0.3125$ per hour. Time together $= \dfrac{1}{1/4+1/16} = 3.20$ hours.
